title: Cobblemon: PvP Enabler
body:
### 📖 Introduction
Cobblemon: PvP Enabler is a Cobblemon sidemod that allows players to face off against each other in a limited-time PvP fight after a Pokémon battle. However, they cannot deal damage to each other without first engaging in a Pokémon battle.

_This mod was requested by **Nappa the capybara** on my Discord server and is a very early version that is currently only available on Fabric._

### 🎉 Features
- **⚔️ PvP after Battles:** Fight other players in PvP after battling their Pokémon!
  
- **✅ Server-side Only**: No need for clients to install anything!

### 🔧 Installation

1. Install Cobblemon and any dependencies.

2. Drop the CobblemonPvPEnabler.jar into your /mods-folder.

3. Start the game or server to generate the config file.

4. Edit /config/cobblemon-pvpenabler.json to customize your settings.
    
Please also note that the Fabric version of this mod requires [fabric-language-kotlin](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-language-kotlin)!


**In case you have any questions or ideas, please do not hesitate to join my [Discord-Server](https://discord.com/invite/yTgZeNvMQ8)!**
